The first YaRN baseline probe hit a stale server on a reused port; fixed with port-free checks + stale-process cleanup, then re-verified.
remaining_limits: A genuinely filled 131072-token input is not feasible here: ~4.9 GiB KV (q4_0) + 4.6 GiB weights vs ~2.7 GiB free RAM and a shared 6 GiB GPU.
Ollama itself still clamps num_ctx to 40960; >40960 requires engine-level YaRN (validated on an isolated llama-server, not wired into Ollama).
Sparse attention, trained compressors and long-context benchmarks (multi-doc, >100k inputs) were not implemented.
All probes are single-run on a shared machine; host contention can shift timings.
